messages:
sara-partners: Quick sync — AcmeEdge (partner) wants a joint demo next Wed 10am PT. They asked for a short runbook we can follow, an estimate for 1M tokens/month in a reserved contract, and answers to a handful of security questionnaire items. can we snap something together?

mike-se: I can own the runbook + demo flow. need to confirm which model variant we'll show (gpt-*-redwood-quant vs open-3b). leaning toward the quantized smaller one to hit latency in the demo.

anna-ops: For the runbook: we should include a quick tenant provisioning step, network rules (egress/IP allowlist), and a fallback to hosted if Dedicated not ready. I'll draft the ops checklist.

ravi-sre: For network egress — AcmeEdge will run from corporate network; they require IP allowlist + outbound to our control plane on 443 only. confirm whether we can provide static egress IPs for the demo.

mike-se: @ravi-sre we can reserve an ephemeral demo gateway with static IPs in staging. anna, can you add the command snippet for tenant create? e.g.:

```
redwood tenant create --name acmeedge-demo --region us-west-2 --capacity reserved --note "partner demo"
```

anna-ops: added. Also adding a small troubleshooting step: if models fail to load, run `redwood infra status --tenant acmeedge-demo` and fallback to hosted by toggling route to `hosted-gg-1`.

lina-sales: On pricing: AcmeEdge asked for a ballpark committed price for 1M tokens/month and a short term PO for 3 months. We should give them a committed discount tier vs on-demand. I'll draft a quick quote: 1M tokens/month -> $X per 1k tokens (rolling up to ~ $Y/mo). Need finance approval but want to present something in the demo follow-up.

sara-partners: Also they sent a security questionnaire with three asks: 1) KMS integration details, 2) data retention for requests, 3) SOC2 evidence for Dedicated customers.

sec-bot: Automated checklist created: [security-q-1738888888] — include KMS section, retention policy, and SOC2 link.

ravi-sre: KMS: we can show customer-managed keys via KMS-HSM + lifecycle notes. Data retention: default 30 days in staging, can be configured to 0 for no retention. I'll paste short text for the questionnaire final answer.

mike-se: For the demo script, propose 12 minutes: 1) 2-min architecture overview, 2) 6-min live demo (tenant provisioning, simple prompt, latency numbers), 3) 3-min ops/deployment Q&A, 1-min next steps/quote. Thoughts?

anna-ops: LGTM. I'll prepare a one-page runbook with steps and expected timings. will include the IP allowlist, sample firewall rule, and the fallback route command.

lina-sales: Can someone drop the quote numbers here by EOD? I want to include them in the follow-up email after demo.

mike-se: Draft quote: committed 1M tokens/mo @ $0.40 per 1k tokens -> $400/mo baseline. burst pricing for >1M at $0.55 per 1k. 3-month PO: we can do no-penalty early termination if usage < 30% of commit. (placeholder, needs finance sign-off).

ravi-sre: Security answers drafted: KMS integration — we support AWS KMS customer-managed keys with envelope encryption; keys never leave KMS. Retention — configurable via tenant policy; default 30 days in staging, option to disable retention. SOC2 — link to report will be provided under NDA; Dedicated customers get attestation. I'll add 2-3 lines for each.

sara-partners: Great. Who will own the follow-up email and the final runbook?

mike-se: I'll send the runbook + recording. anna will attach ops checklist and the quick commands. lina will attach draft quote. ravi will attach the security snippet. I'll put it all together and send the email within 24h after the demo.

anna-ops: putting the runbook in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/demo-runbooks/acmeedge-1738888888 — please review before EOD.

lina-sales: tagging @sara-partners for the demo invite — I'll create the calendar event and include the runbook link. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Reminder set: follow-up doc review in 18 hours.

sara-partners: thank you everyone — big step toward closing. we'll iterate on quote after finance sign-off.

mike-se: quick blocker check — any legal SSO requirements from AcmeEdge? if they need SAML, we should prep the SSO flow screenshots.

lina-sales: They said SAML might be required later; for the demo they just want basic auth and tenant isolation. we'll surface SAML in the next engagement.

ravi-sre: noted. I'll also generate a short performance table for the demo run showing p95 latency and token costs with the quantized variant.

sara-partners: perfect — closing this thread, moving actions to the runbook doc.

mike-se: thanks team :rocket:
